products.name: CheggMate
products.note: Study AI assistant; academic help; student data; content accuracy; honor code implications

profile_text.body:
Chegg is a publicly traded education technology company (NASDAQ: CHGG, CIK 0001364954) that describes itself as providing innovative learning tools and 24/7 homework help across more than 50 subjects. Its site positions the service as offering step-by-step support, real experts, and high-quality solutions enhanced by student feedback, available through Chegg Study and Chegg Study Pack subscription plans.

The company's tracked AI product is CheggMate, categorized as an Education and Research AI tool functioning as a study assistant for academic help. The site references an honor code alongside its privacy and general policies, reflecting the noted considerations around academic integrity, student data, and content accuracy that accompany an AI product in this space. A 2024 survey fielded between September 9 and October 3 among a random sample of U.S. customers drew from approximately 1,039,954 invites with 712 respondents, suggesting a substantial active user base during the periods measured.
